parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags in order to filter the endpoint response on specific actions. For example filter on MAIN in a Football match to only get the main actions like goals, penalties, cards and substitutes.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Skip this number of elements in the response. If provided, it must be a non-negative integer and it must be provided together with the limit parameter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit for the number of elements in the response. If provided, it must be a positive integer and it must be provided together with the skip parameter.

parameters.name: timeBefore
parameters.description: Defined the point in time from which you want to retrieve previous results. It needs to be provided in the ISO time structure: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. If provided, it will only return matches for with a scheduledStartTimeUtc is before this time.
